transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, September 25. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Jeff Bezos' Earth Fund adds $25 million for Pacific Ocean conservation. The Bezos Earth Fund is allocating more than $25 million for ocean conservation projects in five Pacific nations. This funding will support various efforts: enhancing ocean management, establishing marine protected areas, and improving monitoring. The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas. Wife sold shares, bought husband's rupees 7.5 crore property; taxman send notice. When a woman sold her unlisted shares, she reported long-term capital gains of rupees 8.31 crore. In June 2021, she put rupees 6.91 crore into a residential property on Juhu Tara Road, Mumbai, and claimed exemption under Section 54F. 'Whatever is in best interest of team': Gambhir's candid Rohit Sharma admission. Gautam Gambhir shares insights about his journey with Rohit Sharma since their early days representing India. Their bond, shaped by prior experiences, fostered a strong coach-captain dynamic, enhancing their collaborative efforts. He underscores the need for mutual understanding, even amid differing views, stressing that all four captains he partnered with were united in their aspiration for Indian cricket. 'We've never gotten along better': Trump, Xi strike warm tone at White House dinner. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping exchanged warm remarks before joining guests for a White House state dinner, with both leaders speaking about the importance of ties between the two countries and their hopes for a more stable relationship. Watch: Netanyahu holds up pager at UN, recalls Israel's attack on Hezbollah. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held up a pager during his address to the UN General Assembly on Thursday as he defended Israel's military operations against Hamas, Hezbollah and Iran, while dozens of delegates walked out of the hall as he began speaking. Tech exec who slept in sauna can pursue £76M from Gitpod, tribunal rules. Tech executive Shannon Burns can pursue £76 million in compensation from Gitpod after winning a disability discrimination case. Burns was dismissed after sleeping in a sauna during an Austria work trip after forgetting her room key. The tribunal rejected Gitpod's bid to cap her claim at £1 million, while the company's acquisition by OpenAI could affect her shares. EC eyes October electoral roll revision across poll-bound states. EC is likely to order special summary revision (SSR) of electoral rolls in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa and Manipur in Oct, with Jan 1, 2027 as the qualifying date. Mexican land grant from 1843: 5,650-acre Cuyama ranch now protected. Spanish Ranch, a historic 5,650-acre property from the 1843 Mexican land grant, is safely protected from any future development. This initiative not only bolsters sustainable agricultural practices but also safeguards diverse wildlife habitats. A dedicated fundraising campaign, achieving an impressive $1 million, was spearheaded by the California Rangeland Trust, supported by generous contributions from private donors and conservation programs. Opposition set to move fresh motion against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. Opposition parties are preparing to submit fresh notices in Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha to move a motion for the removal of chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar soon, sources said, making this their third attempt to move a motion to remove him. Nokia closes China research hub; recalls CEO's Huawei warning to Europe. Nokia is shutting its Hangzhou radio R and D centre in China by end-2026, cutting around 1,600 jobs, after its Greater China revenue fell over 58 percent since 2018. The closure revives CEO Justin Hotard's pointed question to Europe: why does Huawei still run nearly 60 percent of Germany's 5G sites while Nokia holds under 3 percent share in China? Restructuring charges have tripled to €800 million, even as AI and cloud orders surge 105 percent . Ex-CJI, more legal experts back Tata Sons on Chandra's reappointment. Tata Sons has formally rebuffed Noel Tata's objections to N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as chairman, backing the Sept 17 board decision with legal opinions from three lawyers - senior advocate Sudipto Sarkar, former Chief Justice of India Uday Lalit, and former Supreme Court judge B N Srikrishna.

IPO-bound CJ Darcl is expanding into a trucker marketplace, alternative fuels, EVs and warehousing as it looks to sustain its revenue growth momentum Hedge Fund With 235 percent Return Says Gold Price Decline Is Temporary. Australian hedge fund manager Raphael Lamm, whose long-short gold fund has delivered a net return of more than 200 percent to investors since its launch last year, sees the recent decline in bullion as temporary, arguing that the key forces underpinning its long-term rally remain intact. GLOBAL-MARKETS:Oil jump sends 30-year yields to two-decade high NSE duties unchanged after listing, exchange role will prevail: Chairman. National Stock Exchange (NSE), post its listing on the BSE on Thursday, does not see any change in its duties as a stock trading marketplace and responsibilities as a commercial entity, but if the two lines intersect, the former will have an overriding advantage, its chairperson Srinivas Injeti said. He also said that NSE as an institution has contributed immensely in transforming the Indian capital market from a relatively small market serving a privileged few to a nationwide and vibrant capital market today. Earlier in the day, the National Stock Exchange made its historic debut at the BSE with its shares listing at rupees 1,800 apiece, up by 0.84 per cent from the issue price of rupees 1,785. The public issue marked a significant milestone for the NSE, whose listing plans had remained stalled for nearly a decade amid regulatory hurdles, including those linked to the co-location controversy. Treasury Rout Threatens Popular EM Carry Trade as Citi Pulls Back. The surge that sent US Treasury yields to the highest in decades is threatening carry trades that had become the go-to strategy for emerging-market investors this year. Macquarie sees low growth, market share losses for Angel One; here's why. Macquarie remains 'neutral' on Angel One stock as it believes continued market-share losses, with the need to increase marketing spend, will weigh on growth and profitability. Trump: US-China ties 'never gotten along better'. US President Donald Trump hosted a state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House. Dollar ascends to fresh 2-month high on inflation worry, Fed hike expectations. GLOBAL-FOREX:Dollar ascends to fresh 2-month high on inflation worry, Fed hike expectations Japan stocks rise as technology shares lead gains. Global interest in AI stocks remained strong after Metas Muse personal AI agent renewed investor interest in the sector and supported demand for AI infrastructure. In Japan, Ibiden jumped 14.6 percent , while Advantest gained 3.2 percent , Tokyo Electron rose 1.5 percent , Lasertec added 1.8 percent and Murata Manufacturing increased 0.8 percent . Tata Sons rejects Noel's no, Chandra call valid. Tata Sons has affirmed the validity of N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as chairman following a board majority resolution. Nifty outlook for tomorrow: Why 23,000 matters after breaking below 4-month support? Resistance, support levels Friday. The Nifty index broke down from an inside candle pattern, closing below the crucial 23,070 support level. The bearish trend is indicated by strong selling pressure and a sustained break below 23,000 could lead to further declines. The overall technical outlook is negative. China stocks fall as trade truce uncertainty weighs. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US and China had agreed to extend the trade truce by two months, although China has not officially confirmed the agreement. The extension is also shorter than the three-to-six-month period some US officials had earlier suggested. India at the UN: The elusive permanent spot. India's pursuit of a permanent seat on the United Nations Security Council is bolstered by backing from four European nations. IRDAI commission proposals: Why does Nithin Kamath see regulatory risk as key?. Zerodha CEO Nithin Kamath warned that regulatory risk is the biggest threat to financial businesses after IRDAI's proposed changes to insurance commission rules. The reforms aim to restructure insurance distribution expenses, which could affect commission rates and the economics of fintech models. Arkade Developers completes two years of listing. Congress MP Rahul Gandhi criticized the Election Commission of India for its handling of electoral roll revisions. Vaishali Parekh from Prabhudas Lilladher recommends GAIL, Texmaco Rail, and HBL Engineering for intraday trading today. Suggested buy levels, targets, and stop-loss levels are provided for each stock. Buzzing stock: Raymond hits record high in weak market; up 95 percent in 4 weeks. Raymond's share price hit a new all-time high at rupees 1,196.75, rallying 7 percent in Thursday's intra-day deals on the BSE. LPG customer base dips after a decade. India's LPG customer base had been expanding steadily, with the adoption of cooking gas accelerating over the past decade.

transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Want to repay your debt quickly? To determine adequate coverage, families must evaluate how much financial backing is necessary if the primary breadwinner's income vanishes. This process is designed to ensure that subsidies are provided solely to qualifying households. Authentication can be done through delivery personnel, distributor outlets, or mobile apps provided by oil marketing firms. UPI MDR on loan repayments: What charge applies to EMIs and who bears it? Here's what borrowers need to know. From 15 October, UPI transactions of more than rupees 2,000 for debt collection, including loan repayments and EMI collections, will attract a rupees 5 MDR. The charge is on the merchant side, not the borrower. Here's how it applies to EMIs, AutoPay and credit-linked UPI payments. How employees contributing to EPF on actual wage basis can be impacted due to hike in EPF wage ceiling limit. As of September 17, 2026, the EPF wage ceiling is set to increase from rupees 15,000 to rupees 25,000. This adjustment does not affect employees whose earnings exceed rupees 25,000. Those earning between rupees 15,000 and rupees 25,000 will experience negligible changes to their contributions. Notably, EPS contributions will rise for employees hired prior to September 2014. SEBI launches portfolio managers route for mutual funds: Here's what the new rupees 25 lakh PRIM route means for investors. SEBI has approved a new route allowing portfolio managers to build portfolios using mutual funds, ETFs, index funds and SIFs. With a minimum investment of rupees 25 lakh, PRIM could offer investors a professionally managed alternative to investing directly in mutual funds. Tax audit report filed for AY 2026-27? Key changes include limits on insurer expenses, greater disclosure of commissions, and measures to reduce mis-selling. While these reforms aim to empower consumers, concerns about the impact on market competition and the viability of low-premium policies remain. MoSPI's latest tourism expenditure survey reveals where the biggest expenses are coming from and how spending patterns differ between rural and urban households. 31 of 46 flexi-cap mutual funds delivered positive 1-year returns despite market fall: Check the schemes in red. The central government is taking steps to ensure that employees and pensioners are not affected by the upcoming nationwide bank strike. Salaries and pensions for September 2026 will be disbursed early on September 25. The Department of Expenditure has mandated relevant offices to submit drawals promptly to facilitate this. Any necessary adjustments from the advance payments will be reflected in October's payroll. How to refuse money requests from family and friends without destroying relationships. Lending money to friends and family without clear terms often leads to unreturned funds, damaged relationships, and personal stress. Learning to say no through clear boundaries, delaying responses, and offering alternative solutions can protect both your finances and personal bonds. Second marriage declared void? HC says Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act, can mean that a child born from a second marriage which was proved as void can still inherit the father's property. RBI is exploring offline e-rupee transactions using Bluetooth and NFC, allowing digital payments without internet connectivity. Details here. Know how it affects eligibility, tax benefits, EMI and repayment.
